evals.prompt: This Mastra project has one `weather` agent with inline tools in `src/mastra/index.ts`. I want to move it to the file-based convention with one folder per agent. Can you migrate it? The app runs with `mastra dev`.
evals.expected_output: Creates src/mastra/agents/weather/. config.ts uses agentConfig and keeps the model, instructions.md contains the weather instructions, and separate tool files default-export get_weather and get_forecast. Removes the weather entry from the Mastra agents map in index.ts.
expectations: Creates src/mastra/agents/weather/config.ts that uses agentConfig() and sets model 'openai/gpt-5.5'
config.ts does not pass the instructions string inline because instructions.md owns it
Creates src/mastra/agents/weather/instructions.md containing the weather assistant instructions text
Creates src/mastra/agents/weather/tools/get_weather.ts that default-exports the get_weather tool
Creates src/mastra/agents/weather/tools/get_forecast.ts that default-exports the get_forecast tool
Tool filenames exactly match the original get_weather and get_forecast keys
Removes the weather agent from the new Mastra({ agents }) map in src/mastra/index.ts
Does not leave a duplicate code registration of the weather agent

evals.prompt: Please convert my Mastra `support` agent to a file-based directory. It is defined in src/mastra/agents/support.ts, registered in src/mastra/index.ts, and runs through `mastra dev`. Keep its exact behavior.
evals.expected_output: Creates src/mastra/agents/support/. The dynamic instruction function stays in config.ts. memory.ts default-exports the Memory instance with the same options, and tools/lookup_order.ts default-exports the tool. Removes the old support.ts file, import, and registration while preserving the description.
expectations: Keeps the dynamic instructions function in config.ts rather than moving it to instructions.md
Does not create instructions.md for the dynamic-instruction agent
Creates memory.ts that default-exports a Memory instance preserving lastMessages: 20 and semanticRecall: false
Does not also set memory in config.ts, which would collide with memory.ts
Creates tools/lookup_order.ts default-exporting the lookup_order tool
Preserves the agent description 'Handles customer support questions.' in config.ts
Removes the support agent registration from src/mastra/index.ts and the now-unused import
Deletes or empties the old src/mastra/agents/support.ts so there is no duplicate code agent

evals.prompt: I have a Mastra supervisor that delegates to a researcher. Both are registered in src/mastra/index.ts, and the researcher is in the supervisor's `agents` map. Migrate them to the file-based convention with the researcher as a subagent. The app runs with `mastra dev`.
evals.expected_output: Creates src/mastra/agents/supervisor/ with config.ts and instructions.md. Its subagents/researcher/ directory contains config.ts with a non-empty description, instructions.md, and tools/search.ts. Removes both entries from the code agents map.
expectations: Creates src/mastra/agents/supervisor/ with instructions.md and config.ts using agentConfig with the model
Places the researcher under src/mastra/agents/supervisor/subagents/researcher/
The researcher subagent config.ts sets a non-empty description
Creates the researcher's own tools/search.ts inside the isolated subagent directory
Creates instructions.md for both supervisor and researcher
Removes both supervisor and researcher from the code new Mastra({ agents }) map
Does not leave researcher registered as a top-level code agent
